subject: general
question: The Petrapole-Benapole rail link connects which of the following country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India-Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Petrapole-Benapole rail link** is a vital connection between **India** and **Bangladesh**, facilitating trade and passenger movement between the two neighboring nations.
 
• This rail link connects **Petrapole** in West Bengal, India, to **Benapole** in Bangladesh. Petrapole is located in the **North 24 Parganas district**, while Benapole is in the **Jessore district** of Bangladesh.
 
• It is the **largest land port** in South Asia and serves as a key route for **bilateral trade** between India and Bangladesh. Most of the trade between the two countries happens through this corridor.
 
• The **rail link** was operational during the British era but was disrupted after the partition of India in 1947. It was **revived in 2001** for freight movement and later extended for passenger train services.
 
• The **Maitree Express** and **Bandhan Express** are significant passenger trains that use this rail link, strengthening cultural and people-to-people ties between the two nations.
 
• This rail link has significantly contributed to enhancing **economic cooperation** and fostering **diplomatic relations** between India and Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India-Bangladesh Relations:**

 
 
• India was one of the first countries to recognize Bangladesh after its independence in **1971**.
 
• Both nations share a **4,096 km-long border**, which is the fifth-longest land border in the world.
 
• India and Bangladesh cooperate on various fronts, including **trade, energy, water sharing, and security**.
 
• The two countries signed the **Land Boundary Agreement (LBA)** in 2015 to resolve long-pending border disputes.
 
 
 
• **Other Rail Links Between India and Bangladesh:**
 
 
• **Gede-Darshana Rail Link:** Operational since the British era, this route facilitates cargo and passenger movement.
 
• **Chilahati-Haldibari Rail Link:** Reopened in **2021**, this link connects North Bengal in India with northern Bangladesh.
 
• **Radhikapur-Birol Rail Link:** Primarily used for freight movement, this link connects the two countries through West Bengal and Dinajpur.
 
• **Singhabad-Rohanpur Rail Link:** Another freight corridor, it connects West Bengal (India) to Rajshahi (Bangladesh).
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Petrapole-Benapole Rail Link:**
 
 
• It facilitates the movement of goods such as **textiles, chemicals, and agricultural products** between the two countries.
 
• The link reduces transportation costs and **boosts regional trade** under the framework of SAARC and BIMSTEC.
 
• Passenger train services like the **Maitree Express** and **Bandhan Express** enhance cultural exchanges and strengthen bilateral relations.
 
 
 
• **Trade Relations Between India and Bangladesh:**
 
 
• Bangladesh is India’s **largest trading partner** in South Asia.
 
• India exports items like **cotton, machinery, and iron and steel** to Bangladesh, while importing **jute products, fish, and textiles**.
 
• Bilateral trade between the two countries crossed **USD 10 billion** in recent years, highlighting the strong economic ties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Connectivity Projects Between India and Bangladesh:**

 
 
• **India-Bangladesh Friendship Pipeline:** Aimed at transporting diesel from India’s Numaligarh Refinery to Bangladesh.
 
• **Inland Waterways:** The two countries have agreements to use each other’s **river routes** for trade and transportation.
 
• **Agartala-Akhaura Rail Link:** This under-construction link will connect Tripura (India) with Bangladesh, further enhancing connectivity.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• The Petrapole-Benapole rail link plays a vital role in **India’s Act East Policy**, which aims to strengthen ties with Southeast Asian nations through Bangladesh.
 
• It also supports **regional connectivity** initiatives under BIMSTEC and BBIN (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, and Nepal).
